decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the drawings numbered MMI-01, MMI-03, MMI-04, Location Plan, Received 5th May 2011, MMI-02 Rev A, Received 4th July 2011, submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The window and door formed in the side elevation of the single storey rear infill extension shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and the addition of two windows at ground level on the side elevation of the house.
